turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, Hale? Owen got a zero and nobody called me first.
An answer to what? You haven't shown me a single document.
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.
Admit to what, Hale? Show me what you have, and which section lets you put anything on his transcript by Friday at 3 PM.
Those are the only two options. Pick one.
Two options isn't a procedure. Check your own policy.
